# Audec CLAP gain fixture

This test-only plugin is adapted from Clack's `plugin/examples/gain`, commit
`c5975f9f89f0953b00768680357985d46178078a`, by Prokopyl and Clack
contributors. The source is available under MIT OR Apache-2.0, matching the
upstream example and Clack repository. It is not shipped as an Audec plugin.
